title: Six hundred collaborations, one ring
description: 60 repos · line = shared contributors · hover a repo to light up its world · click to replay

props.name: data
props.description: Ordered repositories with organization indices and nullable nonnegative contributor counts. Diameter remains 3.5 + square root of contributors × 1.7. Only counts at least 26 earn standing labels.

props.name: ties
props.description: Indexed repository pairs and nullable nonnegative shared-contributor counts. Width remains 0.4 + shared × 0.28, including the zero-count relationship baseline. Invalid counts have no link ink.

props.name: organizations
props.description: Ordered organization names. The first five organizations use the preserved semantic tones; later indices use ink. Invalid indices have unavailable membership.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
